meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

copy.tagline: 将上游更新选择性合并到本地定制版本中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着定制版开源项目，需要定期合并上游更新
copy.tagline_en: Selectively merge upstream updates into your customized fork
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized fork and need to regularly merge upstream changes

howto.what: 装完后，你可以通过“/update-nanoclaw”命令让Claude安全地将上游NanoClaw更新合并到你的自定义安装中，同时保留本地修改。它会自动备份、预览更改、合并或选择性挑拣更新，并验证构建和测试。
howto.when: 当你在Claude Code中执行“/update-nanoclaw”命令时触发。该命令会先检查工作区是否干净，然后启动完整的更新流程。

say.text: 运行/update-nanoclaw合并最新上游更新

say.note: 只查看更新日志而不实际合并

howto.what_en: After installation, you can run `/update-nanoclaw` to safely merge upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install while preserving your changes. It automatically backs up, previews changes, merges or cherry-picks updates, and validates builds and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type `/update-nanoclaw` in Claude Code. The command first checks for a clean working tree then starts the update process.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to merge the latest upstream updates

say_en.note: View the changelog without applying any changes
